description: In every structure, the ground equality atom \(s=t\) is true exactly when the actual shared ground terms \(s,t\) have equal values.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.equal_truth.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (t s : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L) (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom.equal t s).Realize M ↔
    FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim t = FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim s
